## Summary

Briefly describe the changes introduced in this Pull Request and the problem it solves.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `test`: Tests addition or update
- [ ] `build` / `chore`: Build, Docker, or CI update

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun x tsc --noEmit` passes with zero errors
- [ ] `bun test` passes
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md` / `CHANGELOG.md`) updated if applicable
- [ ] Stream cleanup and Redis multiplexing invariants are preserved
